The unite criterion is intentionally function-driven: one_second_timer checks cold, warm and temperate cows within ten blocks, implementing Beef Moover below true_cow_tipper.
Chick Buffet uses the native timer to require cold, warm and temperate chickens together within ten blocks; the impossible unite criterion is the grant endpoint, not missing completion logic.
Native count/sheep counts sheep within sixteen blocks and grants at bac_sheep_count 100 or greater; its challenge description and progress hint match the function-driven criterion.

The Three Little Pigs grants through timer checks for all three climate pig variants within ten blocks; its brick icon is thematic, while the impossible criterion retains native group-assembly semantics.

Five tame_animal component-variant criteria require every parrot color; moving Birdkeeper below the Biomes spyglass-at-parrot branch retains the all-variants meaning and current reward/Search identity.
Taming a parrot is the criterion; seed usage is the normal taming mechanism described by the warning. The relocated Biomes message does not retain the removed Animal category ID.

Native count/creaking grants at fifty nearby creakings within forty blocks; the displayed fifty-heart nightmare is implemented through the resulting creatures, with heart_transplanter as its narrative parent.
One OR group accepts killing either drowned rider or zombie-nautilus mount while paired, a plausible jockey defeat. The accepted B5.4 wrapper shim corrects only naughty_lus to naughtylus.

Locked and Loaded checks shelf interaction with a center or correctly oriented side-chain neighbor. It delegates successful swap behavior to the shelf interaction rather than independently testing nine hotbar slots; integration faithfully retains that upstream contract.
At the Rim of the Sky uses a mace smash against the dragon with damage at least 200, matching its full-health one-hit challenge as a damage proxy; the criterion does not independently require a kill.

Oh Baby a Triple is a native function-driven goal: multishot_crossbow_check filters crossbow kills at horizontal distance 30, counts three, and shoot_crossbow resets that count per shot. Its impossible display criterion is the grant endpoint.

Taking the Scenic Route delegates to ordered distance-zone predicates and a native failure helper for gateway, Elytra or Happy Ghast use; the impossible divers_dozen criterion label has no effect on that bridge-travel contract.

Why Do I Hear Boss Music uses jukebox insertion of a jukebox_playable item and a native check for an Ender Dragon within 150 blocks; the function revokes its repeatable technical helper after granting the displayed goal.

Youre Doing It Wrong requires a player mace kill while the attacker has Levitation. It models upward levitation through the effect rather than a velocity test; the ghast criterion label does not restrict the victim.

Certified Spud Chomper counts real poisonous-potato consumption through consume_poisonous_potato, revokes the repeatable helper and grants at 100; its impossible criterion is supported by that exact native counter.
Bouncy Beats completes on obtaining music_disc_bounce. The Sulfur Cave mineshaft wording describes its intended loot source; it does not add a location condition to inventory acquisition.

Copper Golem Overlord is granted by counting living copper_golem entities within ten blocks and testing all four copper armour slots; the native counter threshold is ten, matching the function-driven goal.

Get a Lode Of This moves the lodestone acquisition goal into Mining below The Way to Spawn. The inventory test accepts the new iron-based lodestone item; the recipe wording is guidance, not a separate crafting trigger.
Lodes of Applications checks compass use on a lodestone once in each of Overworld, Nether and End. Its three AND criteria and Adventure use_lodestone parent preserve the moved cross-dimensional goal.

Jockey Jamboree is hidden and thus noncanonical. The native timer starts with a strider jockey and checks the other eight jockey types within sixteen blocks; its impossible criterion is an intentionally hidden grant endpoint.

The Wicked Witch of the West is hidden below Jockey Jamboree; the native timer grants it when a witch riding a chicken is within five blocks. The brush icon is flavour and the impossible criterion is a hidden completion endpoint.

Unwanted Passenger uses the native once-per-second camel-husk/parched passenger counter with threshold thirty and a riding-change failure helper. The missing declared cleanup function is already repaired by the narrow B5.6 forwarding alias.

Lead Zeppelin requires sneaking interaction with a Happy Ghast while bac_leashing_boat is one. The native timer sets that score through on leasher for all_boats, providing the boat-lead connection behind the visible task.
Splatfest uses native egg-type tagging and counts normal, brown and blue airborne eggs within forty-eight blocks. All three scores must reach one hundred before its impossible endpoint is granted.

boss_music_check has no display and is noncanonical; jukebox use with a playable item routes to the repeatable dragon-proximity check rather than exposing a second player-facing advancement.

consume_apple is a no-display helper checking an actual apple consumption. Its consume_spider_eye criterion label is stale naming only; consume_apple rewards count apple days and leave daily revocation to the day controller.

dive_bomb_check is a no-display fall_from_height helper at fifty blocks with no reward. tick_timer clears it when grounded, so it records an airborne fall condition rather than a standalone collection goal.

Constellation still requires a stack of nether stars, but moves beneath Let's Take It Up a Notch. B5.5 removes its obsolete explicit root ordering so the current tree placement is preserved rather than forced into the former branch.

Death From All adds nautilus, zombie nautilus, parched and sulfur cube to its 52 mandatory death sources. The current Hardcore authority intentionally replaces deaths with nonblocked hurt events and its own matching description, so the main death goal is not incorrectly imposed on Hardcore.

Dragon vs Dragon II: Electric Boogaloo retains the function-granted impossible criterion. Native respawn/kill-dragon bookkeeping and the airborne dragon-head fail check implement the goal, while the new bac_dragon progress hint describes that same eligibility state.

Dragon vs Wither: The Pre-Sequel retains its function-granted criterion and Dragon II parent. Native wither-respawn, cooldown and airborne dragon-head checks lead to the wither-kill grant; the new bac_dragon hint does not change its completion grouping.

Farlander remains a hidden extreme-distance challenge with four alternative X/Z thresholds at plus or minus 29999983. Modern spectator filtering preserves its world-border objective beneath A Million Blocks Away.

Overwarden remains function-granted; the native wardens counter counts within distance 100 and grants at 50. Its bac_overwarden_count tracker also targets 50, matching the description and the added progress hint.

Potion Master modernizes direct_entity from potion to splash_potion and expands to 85 mandatory mob kills with nine additions. The exact upstream victim roster, including Enderman, is retained beneath Endergeddon without ATD goal substitution.

Stack All the Blocks adds the same 97 current blocks as All the Blocks and reaches 999 mandatory criteria. Its eight explicit exclusions match the description; signs/banners use 16, ordinary stackable blocks 64 and unstackable beds/shulkers/cake one, with chain modernized to iron_chain.

Stack All the Items adds 46 current items to 366 requirements without losing old criteria. Its one tagged smithing-template stack and excluded sherds/recovery compass match the description, while nonstackable equipment remains single-item rather than an impossible 64-stack.

The Perfect Run moves beneath At the Rim of the Sky and adds a bac_perfect_run hint. Its dragon, wither and raid victories remain mandatory and gated by the technical start state; native start/fail bookkeeping retains the thirty-second and damage-reset semantics.

Silent But Deadly explicitly adds sprinting to its existing sneaking-on-sculk, Speed II and Swift Sneak III predicate. The revised tongue-twister description now states both simultaneous movement flags; ATD preserves that upstream goal.

Dogfight uses the current skeletons_with_bows tag, whose four members include parched alongside skeleton, stray and bogged. Both victim and player still need levitation; B8-R2's generic Skeleton description and unchanged Search identity match this skeletal-family goal.

Dragon vs Dragon remains function-granted after the technical dragon kill with bac_dvd eligibility; its new bac_dragon progress hint describes the existing dragon-head challenge rather than introducing another criterion.

Good Luck Getting This One preserves its hidden one-arrow challenge with five specified End victims, including a baby turtle, and a crossbow fired-from condition. Modern entity keys preserve all five simultaneous victims.

A Gluttonous Diet removes the enchanted-golden-apple stack and explicitly documents that exception. Its remaining 39 food requirements retain stacks of ordinary foods, 16 honey bottles and single unstackable stews beneath Balanced Diet.

I'm Gonna Be Sick groups 42 stew variants into ten required effect families, allowing village/chest duration variants instead of requiring each source. Poison 10-20-second and other added variants retain their correct effect IDs; the nausea stew remains a separate required family.
Copper Miner is now a task beneath Copper Age rather than a goal under the former copper branch. Its raw_copper count remains 64, and green styling now agrees with the task frame.
Master Copper Miner changes from challenge to goal beneath Copper Golem Overlord, with blue goal styling. It still requires 64 copper blocks, matching the stack-of-blocks description.

Sly Copper narrows from 72 to 40 stacks: five named copper block/cut/chiseled families across four oxidation stages and waxed variants. Removing door/trapdoor/grate/bulb families matches its revised description and move beneath School of Hard Knocks.

The Statue of Liberty now collects a fully oxidized copper-golem statue, waxed or unwaxed, instead of an arbitrary oxidized copper block. Its statue icon, new Total Copout parent and revised description agree with the new item predicate.

Dead Really Don't Die still awards on a thrown Totem being picked up by a zombie. The description's later kill-twice phrase explains the purpose of giving the Totem; the native predicate does not require those subsequent kills, and ATD preserves this existing award point.

Impossible explicitly requires melee player-attack damage while holding an arrow, tipped arrow or spectral arrow, and removes the old five-block heuristic. Its joke is killing with the held arrow rather than shooting the teleporting Enderman; the native predicate makes that intent clear.

Pupil Poppers changes from a used-item stat predicate to an impossible function-granted advancement with a progress hint. Its current PUPIL_POPPERS SCORE binding uses bac_consume_spider_eye and goal 1000, matching the consumption-based goal rather than the obsolete stat mechanism.

Jenga retains the exact nested vehicle chain: player on strider on strider on a boat on a minecart. The modern entity keys preserve each level rather than flattening this intentionally unusual riding goal.

Gas Bomb adds nausea as its twenty-first required creeper effect and allows fire charge alongside flint-and-steel for ignition. All effect branches retain the creeper subject, so the extra ignition tool is a documented upstream alternative rather than a mismatched reward identity.
Engineer expands 68 to 70 required component families by adding shelf and copper chest; wood and copper alternatives are OR choices within each component, not a demand for every material variant.
Master Engineer mirrors the 70 Engineer component families, including shelf and copper chest; stackable components require 64, armor stands 16, while carts and boats appropriately require one.

Target Practise expands 10 to 12 AND projectile tests with blue and brown eggs; the ordinary egg gains its own Item-id predicate so the three egg criteria express distinct variants rather than one shared egg hit.

Travelling Bard adds sulfur caves to 37 required biome families; grouped related forest, snow and End variants remain alternatives inside family criteria, consistent with biome types rather than every individual biome.

Loot 'em! changes only title punctuation from Loot ‘Em!; its impossible criterion is intentionally function-granted for ten loot chests, with the same bac_stat_loot_chest tracker and Statistics anchor.

Open Loot Chest keeps its OR of vanilla and Terralith container-loot tables and relocates the statistics handler; optional Terralith identities do not demand completing all tables or enable companion content in Main.

Riddle First Line correctly requires a vanishing-cursed compass, but its Challenges-root check is doubly nested under conditions.minecraft:type_specific/player instead of conditions.player. The real InventoryChangeTrigger codec reads player/slots/items only, so that purported gate is ignored; native and effective ATD definitions match, with no ATD-specific intent to guess.
nonPassRecords.resolution: Document exact upstream behavior; no product mutation or speculative upstream repair.

nonPassRecords.manualReason: Riddle Ninth Line keeps spyglass use while boating, holding a map and carrying a shoulder parrot after line eight; removing the vehicle water-block constraint permits the same pirate tableau on land, with four hand/shoulder alternatives.
Riddle Tenth Line remains impossible and function-granted; the native place_warped_button counter grants this helper at 1000, while the relocated empty reward avoids a duplicate player-facing reward.

Riddle Third Line retains the previous-step gate and 100000 cm OR ride counter, adding happy-ghast and nautilus distances to horse, pig and strider; native timer initialization and second-line resets supply both new counters.

Axeman expands six axes to seven with copper and replaces the five-block proximity heuristic with explicit player-attack damage; all seven material attacks remain AND-gated and the description no longer says six.

Demolitions Expert expands its TNT-explosion victim AND roster from 35 to 40 with five undead riding-family entities; existing victims and direct TNT identity remain required, faithfully retaining the native hostile-mob challenge.
Egging, Dude! adds blue and brown egg alternatives to one OR group; the Item-id NBT distinguishes the three egg variants, and cached 26.2 ThrowableItemProjectile writes the same uppercase Item key.
Master Shieldsman adds zombie nautilus and parched to 35 required blocked-damage source criteria; all victims remain AND-gated, with the shield challenge still testing deflection rather than kills.

Multiclassed adds a spear family, permits mace strike or smash, and preserves trident melee-or-thrown alternatives; bow/crossbow now require actual weapon-identified hits, TNT uses explosion damage, and rod hits exclude non-mobs.

Poseidon vs. Hades expands eleven to twelve Nether-creature families with happy ghast and allows melee or thrown trident kills per family; only skeleton retains a Nether-location condition, faithfully preserving the native origin-based roster.
Shovel Knight adds copper to seven AND-required shovel attacks, replaces proximity with explicit melee damage and removes the obsolete six-shovels wording; its Axeman parent remains appropriate.

The Aquatic Hunter adds nautilus and zombie nautilus to fifteen aquatic families, each requiring either melee or thrown trident kill; the AND-of-OR structure permits either trident use for every family.
The Mighty Hunter adds skeleton horse, zoglin, zombie horse and camel husk to 32 land-animal victims; arrows must now record a bow weapon, so crossbow shots cannot satisfy the bow-specific challenge.

There's yolk on my head accepts any of the three egg variants hitting the zombies tag, broadening the old zombie victim while retaining one OR group; head wording is playful rather than a precise hit-location predicate.

When Pigs Finally Fly retains a hooked pig at absolute distance at least 25; the description says below, but the unchanged native predicate measures radial distance rather than vertical displacement, with no ATD distortion.

Adventuring Time retains 27 AND-required surface-biome families with related biome variants as alternatives and spectators excluded; its Wet Feet parent and approved Terralith specialization preserve biome-family exploration ownership.

Bullseye retains signal 15 and horizontal distance 30, but entity_type:arrow is outside the entity_properties predicate; the current loot-condition codec reads predicate/entity, so the arrow restriction is ignored. Exact native and ATD effective definitions match; the Redstone Search identity is correct and no ATD repair is inferred.

nonPassRecords.manualReason: Monsters Hunted expands 38 to 43 singleton AND kills with five undead riding-family victims; boss and existing monster criteria remain required under Dungeon Crawler rather than becoming alternatives.
Take Aim retains normal-or-spectral arrow hits but now requires projectile weapon NBT identifying a bow; the change makes the bow-and-arrow description precise and excludes crossbow shots.

Sniper Duel retains arrow or spectral-arrow kills at horizontal distance at least 50 and uses the skeletons_with_bows tag, including current parched alongside skeleton/stray/bogged; the bow branch remains coherent.
Is it a Plane? moves from Dragon Shield to the End root while keeping spyglass use looking at the Ender Dragon; the new parent permits observation without first completing a dragon-defense challenge.
Is it a Bird? follows Chatterbox from Animals to Biomes and relocates its reward to biomes/is_it_a_bird; the parrot-through-spyglass criterion and current message/Search identity follow that move.
Star Trader retains one OR over villager trades at y>=319 Overworld or y>=255 Nether/End; the dimension-specific build-height thresholds and Lilypad Hatter parent remain coherent.

Remote Getaway retains an OR between entering an End gateway and reaching any End x/z boundary at +/-750, excluding spectators on location alternatives; reaching outer islands without a gateway remains an intentional native route.

The breed-every-animal challenge changes title Overpopulation to Two By Two and reward to animal/two_by_two, adding nautilus for 27 AND criteria; the 2500-breeding statistics tracker separately follows statistics/overpopulation, avoiding swapped-name confusion.

Shear Brilliance retains shears interaction with a wolf beneath Repair Wolf Armor; the native event predicate does not independently test prior armor state, and ATD preserves that upstream interaction scope faithfully.

Wax On adds 24 recipes for six new copper families across four oxidation states to its single OR group; any recipe or direct honeycomb waxing still suffices, rather than requiring every copper variant.

How Did We Get Here? adds Breath of the Nautilus to the simultaneous effect map under Global Vaccination; all 34 listed effects must coexist in one effects-changed criterion, unlike lifetime effect collection.

Uneasy Alliance retains killing a ghast in the Overworld beneath Ghast Slayer; the native predicate checks the final dimension, not a recorded prior Nether journey, and ATD faithfully preserves that endpoint semantics.

The Wicked Witch of the West is hidden below Jockey Jamboree; the native timer grants it when a witch riding a chicken is within five blocks. The brush icon is flavour and the impossible criterion is a hidden completion endpoint.
boss_music_check has no display and is noncanonical; jukebox use with a playable item routes to the repeatable dragon-proximity check rather than exposing a second player-facing advancement.

consume_apple is a no-display helper checking an actual apple consumption. Its consume_spider_eye criterion label is stale naming only; consume_apple rewards count apple days and leave daily revocation to the day controller.

consume_honey_bottle is a no-display repeatable helper whose reward adds bac_consume_honey_bottle, revokes itself and grants Wheres the Honey Lebowski at one hundred. The item, counter and goal agree.
consume_poisonous_potato is a noncanonical no-display consumption helper; its reward increments the exact poisonous-potato counter and grants Certified Spud Chomper at one hundred.

consume_spider_eye is a no-display repeatable item-consumption helper; its reward increments bac_consume_spider_eye and grants Pupil Poppers at one thousand, matching the updated SCORE tracker objective.

dive_bomb_check is a no-display fall_from_height helper at fifty blocks with no reward. tick_timer clears it when grounded, so it records an airborne fall condition rather than a standalone collection goal.

multishot_crossbow_check is a noncanonical repeatable killed_by_arrow helper filtered by Multishot crossbow and a victim thirty horizontal blocks away; its counting reward supports the displayed three-kill challenge.
place_warped_button is a no-display helper gated by completion of riddle_ninth_line; its repeatable reward counts button placements toward one thousand and then grants riddle_tenth_line.

scenic_route_fail is a no-display OR of riding Happy Ghast, entering an End Gateway or flying. Its lack of reward is intentional because the Scenic Route controller checks and revokes the failure marker.
shoot_crossbow is a no-display shot_crossbow helper whose reward resets the triple-kill counter and revokes itself, making the displayed Multishot challenge per-shot rather than a lifetime count.

unwanted_passenger_fail is a no-display started_riding reset helper. Its declared missing native reward ID is deliberately retained and resolved through the accepted forwarding alias to the real cleanup function.
